notes: Official 2026 USMLE nervous-system outline includes cerebrovascular/brainstem disorders.

Locked-in Syndrome StatPearls last updated July 24, 2023 in the 2026 edition; ventral pons/basilar disease, corticospinal and corticobulbar injury, preserved arousal and vertical eye movements directly supported.

duplicate_gate.selected_construct: Locked-in syndrome from bilateral ventral pontine corticospinal/corticobulbar injury with dorsal arousal sparing

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Basilar thrombosis with ventral pontine infarction, quadriplegia, anarthria, preserved consciousness/blinking/vertical gaze localizes to bilateral ventral pontine descending tracts with dorsal reticular activating system spared.
adversarial_second_pass.dorsal_pons_attack: Destroying the ascending reticular activating system would impair consciousness.
adversarial_second_pass.internal_capsule_attack: Bilateral capsular motor injury does not explain the characteristic pontine ocular/bulbar pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.medulla_attack: Medial medullary disease does not produce the full classic locked-in neuroanatomic pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.akinetic_mutism_attack: Akinetic mutism is impaired initiation from frontal/cingulate circuitry, not conscious attempted communication trapped by motor pathway disruption.
